message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Why does Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L run so slowly and oddly on a TitanXP with LM Studio?","body":"A user running Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L in LM Studio on a TitanXP (12GB VRAM) with 32GB RAM reports the model is \"incredibly slow,\" taking over 14 seconds to respond to simple prompts and sometimes performing unexpected math calculations even when not prompted.
